name: evidence
trans: n. your basis for belief or disbelief; knowledge on which to base belief; an indication that makes something evident
v. provide evidence for; stand as proof of; show by one's behavior, attitude, or external attributes; provide evidence for

name: alternative
trans: n. one of a number of things from which only one can be chosen
adj. serving or used in place of another; necessitating a choice between mutually exclusive possibilities

name: intention
trans: n. an anticipated outcome that is intended or that guides your planned actions; (usually plural) the goal with respect to a marriage proposal

name: relevant
trans: adj. having a bearing on or connection with the subject at issue

name: outline
trans: v. describe roughly or briefly or give the main points or summary of
n. the line that appears to bound an object; a sketchy summary of the main points of an argument or theory

name: extinct
trans: adj. no longer in existence; lost or especially having died out leaving no living representatives

name: wing
trans: n. a movable organ for flying (one of a pair); one of the horizontal airfoils on either side of the fuselage of an airplane
v. travel through the air; be airborne

name: nest
trans: n. a structure in which animals lay eggs or give birth to their young; a kind of gun emplacement
v. inhabit a nest, usually after building; fit together or fit inside

name: interference
trans: n. a policy of intervening in the affairs of other countries; the act of hindering or obstructing or impeding

name: standard
trans: n. a basis for comparison; a reference point against which other things can be evaluated; the ideal in terms of which something can be judged
adj. conforming to or constituting a standard of measurement or value; or of the usual or regularized or accepted kind; commonly used or supplied

name: subtopic
trans: 副主题

name: therapy
trans: n. (medicine) the act of caring for someone (as by medication or remedial training etc.)

name: morality
trans: n. concern with the distinction between good and evil or right and wrong; right or good conduct; motivation based on ideas of right and wrong

name: participation
trans: n. the act of sharing in the activities of a group

name: faculty
trans: n. one of the inherent cognitive or perceptual powers of the mind; the body of teachers and administrators at a school

name: fit
trans: v. be agreeable or acceptable to; be the right size or shape; fit correctly or as desired
adj. meeting adequate standards for a purpose; (usually followed by 'to' or 'for') on the point of or strongly disposed
n. a display of bad temper; a sudden uncontrollable attack

name: useful
trans: adj. being of use or service

name: confuse
trans: v. mistake one thing for another; be confusing or perplexing to; cause to be unable to think clearly

name: inconvenient
trans: adj. not suited to your comfort, purpose or needs

name: valuable
trans: adj. having great material or monetary value especially for use or exchange; having worth or merit or value

name: advisor
trans: n. an expert who gives advice

name: forget
trans: v. dismiss from the mind; stop remembering; be unable to remember

name: lecturer
trans: n. a public lecturer at certain universities; someone who lectures professionally

name: content
trans: n. everything that is included in a collection and that is held or included in something; what a communication that is about something is about
v. satisfy in a limited way; make content

name: practical
trans: adj. concerned with actual use or practice; guided by practical experience and observation rather than theory

name: improvement
trans: n. a change for the better; progress in development; the act of improving something

name: repetitive
trans: adj. repetitive and persistent

name: village
trans: n. a community of people smaller than a town; a settlement smaller than a town

name: mission
trans: n. an organization of missionaries in a foreign land sent to carry on religious work; an operation that is assigned by a higher headquarters

name: qualification
trans: n. an attribute that must be met or complied with and that fits a person for something; the act of modifying or changing the strength of some idea

name: curriculum
trans: n. an integrated course of academic studies

name: training
trans: n. activity leading to skilled behavior

name: colleague
trans: n. an associate that one works with; a person who is member of one's class or profession

name: description
trans: n. a statement that represents something in words

name: administration
trans: n. a method of tending to or managing the affairs of a some group of people (especially the group's business affairs)

name: farming
trans: n. the practice of cultivating the land or raising stock

name: damage
trans: n. the occurrence of a change for the worse; loss of military equipment
v. inflict damage upon

name: checklist
trans: n. a list of items (names or tasks etc.) to be checked or consulted

name: figures
trans: n. a diagram or picture illustrating textual material; alternative names for the body of a human being
v. judge to be probable; be or play a part of or in

name: presentation
trans: n. the activity of formally presenting something (as a prize or reward); a show or display; the act of presenting something to sight or view

name: professor
trans: n. someone who is a member of the faculty at a college or university

name: seminar
trans: n. any meeting for an exchange of ideas

name: chemistry
trans: n. the science of matter; the branch of the natural sciences dealing with the composition of substances and their properties and reactions

name: trade
trans: n. the commercial exchange (buying and selling on domestic or international markets) of goods and services; the skilled practice of a practical occupation
v. engage in the trade of; turn in as payment or part payment for a purchase

name: payment
trans: n. a sum of money paid or a claim discharged; the act of paying money

name: portable
trans: adj. easily or conveniently transported

name: comedy
trans: n. light and humorous drama with a happy ending; a comic incident or series of incidents

name: pattern
trans: n. a perceptual structure; a customary way of operation or behavior
v. plan or create according to a model or models

name: fresh
trans: adj. recently made, produced, or harvested; (of a cycle) beginning or occurring again
adv. very recently

name: application
trans: n. the act of bringing something to bear; using it for a particular purpose; a verbal or written request for assistance or employment or admission to a school

name: employee
trans: n. a worker who is hired to perform a job

name: evaporate
trans: v. lose or cause to lose liquid by vaporization leaving a more concentrated residue
